title: Interest deposit succeeded
description: This event occurs when an interest deposit is successfully registered with product interest management.

tracking_id.title: Tracking ID.
tracking_id.description: Unique deposit identifier defined by Customer.

interest_plan_id.title: Interest Plan ID identifier
interest_plan_id.description: A custom identifier string that indicates the interest plan to be used in the rate calculations.

value_date.title: Value date
value_date.description: Date that deposit was effectively issued by client

maturity_date.title: Issuing date
maturity_date.description: Date that deposit expires, finishing rentability cycle

has_asset_registration.title: Has Asset Registration
has_asset_registration.description: Indicates if the interest deposit must be registered as a asset

customer_name.title: Customer name
customer_name.description: Name of interest deposit owner. Can be a company or an individual.

document_number.title: Customer document number
document_number.description: Number of interest deposit owner's legal document

customer_type.title: Entity type
customer_type.description: Legal nature of interest deposit owner

created_at.title: Created date
created_at.description: Creation date of interest deposit on Pismo platform
